info.title: County and state unemployment: BLS Local Area Unemployment Statistics, annual averages and latest month: data API
info.summary: Static, read-only JSON and CSV files. No key, no sign-up. CORS open.
info.description:
County and state unemployment: BLS Local Area Unemployment Statistics, annual averages and latest month: The unemployment rate, number unemployed, employed and labor force for every county and state, from the Bureau of Labor Statistics' Local Area Unemployment Statistics (LAUS) program: the annual average for each year 2015 to 2025 and the latest 13 months. Each county and state record carries the latest annual average, the change from the year before and since 2015, and the latest month (preliminary until BLS revises it). County figures are model-based estimates that BLS controls to its state totals; the build checks that county employment, unemployment and labor force add up to the state's. Retired Alaska census-area codes with no current estimate are left out, and Connecticut appears as BLS publishes it.

Probative is a marketing firm, not a law firm; not legal advice. Every JSON response starts with a "meta" object holding the credit line, citation, DOI and license (CC BY 4.0).
